✅ Done. I've created a comprehensive UTC-based date utilities module:

**Created src/dates.js with three functions:**

**isValidDate(text)** - Validates dates in YYYY-MM-DD format
- Checks format matches YYYY-MM-DD
- Validates dates are real (Feb 29 only in leap years, etc.)
- Handles all leap year rules correctly
- Uses UTC date validation

**addDays(dateStr, n)** - Adds/subtracts days from a date
- Takes YYYY-MM-DD string and day count (can be negative)
- Returns new date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- Correctly handles month/year boundaries
- All arithmetic in UTC

**daysBetween(a, b)** - Calculates days between two dates
- Returns b - a in whole days (can be negative)
- Both parameters YYYY-MM-DD strings
- Precise day calculation in UTC
- Consistent with addDays: daysBetween(a, addDays(a, n)) == n

**Design decisions:**
- All dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings everywhere in the system
- All date arithmetic uses UTC, never local timezone
- Uses Date constructor with 'T00:00:00Z' suffix to force UTC
- Updated createInvoice to use isValidDate from dates module

**Added 19 tests:**
- Format validation (valid dates, invalid formats, whitespace rejection)
- Leap year handling (2000, 1900, 2023, 2024)
- Day arithmetic (positive/negative/zero, boundaries)
- Large date ranges (365+ days, multi-year)
- UTC behavior verification
- Consistency checks (addDays/daysBetween compatibility)

**Test results:** All 131 tests pass ✓
